summary: THE frozen definition of what a notebook note must carry to be findable, and the only place the spec shapes are written down. SPEC_SHAPES holds one example string per spec type (file-single/file-hub/flow/lesson) rendered by shapesBlock({compact}) — compact drops the prose for the capture prompt, both emit the SAME examples. NOTE_CHECKS holds one entry per way a note ends up unfindable, each with TWO predicates: missingInSpec (the JSON just written) and missingInNote (the folded note). It lives in hooks/ and not src/ because the capture hooks never import from dist/; the TS side imports it across directories and tsc's rootDir does NOT object (types come from note-shape.d.mts beside it). Template literals here open with a newline so dedent() can strip the common prefix and keep RELATIVE indentation — that is what makes a JSON example's continuation lines line up under it.
